caption: The drawing features a single oval-shaped object oriented vertically and centrally placed within a rectangular white background. Inside the oval, which is outlined with a repeating scalloped pattern in a dark brown color, there is a light beige, elongated organic form resembling a curled, abstract human figure with arms raised over the head, centrally placed and oriented vertically. The figure occupies most of the height of the oval. Surrounding the figure within the oval is a textured, furrowed brown field that radiates outward, growing darker toward the scalloped edge. At the top of the oval, there is a small circular loop, resembling a hanging mechanism. The overall color scheme consists of various shades of brown and beige, with the oval and figure contrasting against the white background. There are no other objects or forms present within the composition.
title: Burnt Plaque
